title: A constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on a qcqs scheme is the inverse image of one on a Noetherian scheme
statement:
Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring and $F$ a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], an object of $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then there are a Noetherian scheme $X'$ (locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact; one may take $X'$ of finite type over $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$), a morphism of schemes $
u:X	o X'$, a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules $F'$ on $X'_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] and an isomorphism of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules $
u^{-1}F'\cong F$, where $
u^{-1}$ is the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. (Stacks states the underlying Lemma 09YU (3) for Noetherian $\Lambda$; a finite ring is Noetherian.)

source.place: Lemma 09Z7 (lemma-constructible-maps-into-constant-general), proof, first paragraph up to 'is the pullback of a similar constructible sheaf F_t over X_t for some t' (etale-cohomology.tex ~line 13066), which combines Limits, Proposition 01ZA (limits-proposition-approximate) and the essential surjectivity part of Lemma 09YU (3) (lemma-category-is-colimit, etale-cohomology.tex line 12552)
